body.notes: CRAWLED-NOT-INDEXED review 2026-09-08. Operator supplied 71 URLs expecting a day of page optimisation; there is almost nothing there. Classified: 34 RSS feeds, 20 PDF spec sheets, 7 wp-emoji-release.min.js versions, 2 ?ref=aftership variants, 1 jkit AJAX endpoint, 1 wc-api Stripe endpoint, and only 6 actual page URLs. Checked all 6 live in headless Chrome: /author/mammoth/ 301s to home (so all THREE author archives are handled, mammoth was previously unknown); /product/wl7000-wheel-loader/ and /product/wl4000-wheel-loader/ are proper 404+noindex (old model numbers, correctly gone); /elementor-hf/footer-2/ is 404 (template NOT publicly exposed); /product/tt570/ is 200 but canonicals correctly to /tt570-mini-dumper/ (page id 1476) because TT570 is one of only 2 machines still existing as a live Woo product (other is the 2000MT). ONE REAL FAULT, QUEUED as pending 1188: /product-category/mini-excavators/full-size-track-loaders/ serves 200 with 145 words and NO H1, and its canonical points at /product-category/full-size-track-loaders/ which itself 301s, i.e. canonical-to-a-redirect. 301d straight to /full-size-track-loaders/ (verified 200). PDFs: 25 in the library, 5 duplicate pairs (120MT, TL5500, TT570, WL7500, X-loader-100MT), each an old 2025-09 copy plus a newer 2026-04/06 copy. VERIFIED all 5 product pages link the NEWER copy, so no customer gets stale specs; the 5 old ones are orphans, library weight only, not a content fault. The 2022/10 MT2850 PDF Google crawls is NOT in the media library at all (orphaned file on disk, WP cannot delete it). REMAINING SMALL ITEMS (not queued): (a) /?jkit-ajax-request=jkit_elements returns full HTML with robots index and NO canonical at all, the only indexable+unconsolidated URL on the list; fix is a robots.txt Disallow on the parameter, NOT a noindex. (b) wp-emoji-release.min.js loads site-wide, dead weight, same dequeue pattern as the Woo scripts. ROUTE LEARNED: draft_create_redirect is POST cc-assistant/v1/draft/redirect with params source, destination, http_code (301/302/307/410/451), reasoning, summary. NOT /draft/create-redirect (404). Read off class-rest-api.php:852. Handler guards self-loops and requires the Rank Math Redirections module.
